patch.value: Mixed linked-resource remove and add in one command silently favors removal

The linked files/docs command accepts --remove and --add for the same path in one invocation, reports success, and leaves the path removed. Define and enforce an explicit conflict or atomic replace contract so evidence-maintenance intent cannot be silently lost.

Same-path remove-plus-add has an explicit public contract; CLI and SDK apply the same contract to files and docs; zero partial history transitions are written; focused and manual regressions cover conflicting and non-conflicting compound mutations
Make compound linked-resource mutations deterministic and lossless
Agents can update evidence metadata without a successful command silently deleting the intended replacement
Prevents context loss during file and doc link maintenance
Same-path remove-plus-add either atomically replaces the entry or fails with actionable guidance
Observed while correcting linked evidence for pm-cg1sjb during PR #983
Run pm files <id> --remove <path> --add path=<path>,scope=project,note=<new>; inspect pm get <id> and observe that the path is absent
The command preserves the added replacement or rejects the contradictory mutation before writing history
The command succeeds but removal wins and the requested replacement is absent
linked files/docs CLI and SDK mutation orchestration
